output: ^ide/styles\.css line \d+: labelled /png, the bytes are a PNG$
^ide/styles\.css line \d+: labelled image/png, the bytes are a GIF$
^ide/styles\.css line \d+: labelled image/png, the bytes are a JPEG$
^[1-9]\d* of \d+ images in the IDE's stylesheets are mislabelled \(BETA \d+\)$

steps:
1. Open ide\styles.css, in the folder of the twinBASIC installation, in a text editor.
2. Go to line 2947 (line 2935 in BETA 957). It is background-image: url('data:/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...'), the rule of .treeExpanded and .sectionExpanderIcon. The media type of the data: URI is /png, with no image in front of the slash. Decode the base64 after the comma: the first eight bytes are 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A, the signature of a PNG. Line 2952 (.treeExpanded1) is the same.
3. Go to line 3917 (BETA 957: 3905), the rule of #progressSpinner and .progressSpinnerIcon. It is url('data:image/png;base64,R0lGODlh...'). Decode the base64: the first six bytes are 47 49 46 38 39 61, GIF89a, a GIF.
4. Go to line 7412 (BETA 957: 7323), the rule of .vipGold1_autoWeighingSystemsLogo. It is url('data:image/png;base64,/9j/4AAQ...'). Decode the base64: the first three bytes are FF D8 FF, the start of a JPEG.
5. Every other image the style sheets embed has the type its bytes have.
scripts/probe_ide_image_labels.mjs does this for every image in the .css files of the installation (the newest twinBASIC_IDE_BETA_<n> folder on the Desktop, or --ide <twinBASIC.exe>) and prints one line for each that is mislabelled. On BETA 1005, 997 and 957 it prints the same four.
